title: Page 32 spiral turns did not pass the page-boundary holdout
claim: The frozen six spiral turns overlapped four of six internal page-boundary blocks, but the exact hypergeometric upper-tail p-value of 0.091908092 did not pass the 0.01 threshold.
why_it_matters: It records a suggestive visual overlap without overstating it as supported correspondence.
controls: Exact frozen positions and exact hypergeometric test.
No shifted corner or alternate boundary convention.
limitations: Only the exact declared position sets were tested.
does_not_claim: That every relationship between Page 32 and page boundaries is invalid.
current_interpretation: Bounded negative for the exact spiral-turn/page-boundary correspondence.
